<title id="a-title">Cache structures: CPU core, Address split, Set, Way, Cache Line, Memory Block, Offset, Byte, Bit</title>
<desc id="a-desc">A CPU chip contains a CPU core and L1 Cache of two sets with four ways each. Each way position contains a cache line entry. RAM, shown only as a dashed outside reference, holds Memory Block B. Address 40 decimal is split into Tag 1 (11 bits), Index 0 (1 bit), Offset 8 (4 bits). Index 0 selects Set 0; Tag 1 matches the stored tag in Way 3; Offset 8 selects Byte 8. The mathematical example shows all four formulas: Tag, Index, Offset, and Block Base. Set zero Way three contains Cache Line B with Tag one, a copy of RAM Block B. The line expands to 16 bytes and selected Byte eight expands to eight bits. Selected Byte 8 uses amber Offset color. Equations are vector MathText paths, scaled uniformly and laid out in two columns by two rows. The magnified Cache Line B panel is bottom-aligned with Set 1.</desc>

$$
\mathrm{Tag}=\left\lfloor\frac{a}{B\cdot S}\right\rfloor

$$
\mathrm{Index}=\left\lfloor\frac{a}{B}\right\rfloor\bmod S
$$

</div>

</div>

<div class="nodal-cols nodal-cols-2">

<div class="nodal-col">

**Block Offset**

$$
\mathrm{Offset}=a\bmod B
$$

</div>

<div class="nodal-col">

**Block Base**

$$
\mathrm{Block\ Base}=\left\lfloor\frac{a}{B}\right\rfloor\cdot B
$$

</div>

**Direct-Mapped**：1 Way per Set；Memory Block 的数据副本只能存入指定 Set 的唯一 Cache Line

**N-way Set-Associative**：N Ways per Set（\(N>1\)）；Memory Block 的数据副本可存入指定 Set 的任意 Cache Line

**Fully Associative**：1 Set，包含全部 Cache Lines；Memory Block 的数据副本可存入任意 Cache Line；Index = 0 bits

<small style="color:var(--nodal-svg-muted);font-size:0.85em">Way = 每个 Set 中的位置编号；一个 (Set, Way) 对应一条 Cache Line；Empty Cache Line 仍存在，只是 Valid = 0</small>

**Memory Hierarchy**

$$
\text{Registers}\;\rightarrow\;
\left[\begin{smallmatrix}\text{L1-I}\\[-2pt]\text{L1-D}\end{smallmatrix}\right]
\;\rightarrow\;\text{L2}\;\rightarrow\;\text{L3}\;\rightarrow\;
\underbrace{\text{RAM}}_{\text{Main Memory}}\;\rightarrow\;
\underbrace{\text{SSD / HDD}}_{\text{Permanent Storage}}
$$

$$
\footnotesize\text{L1-I}=\text{Instruction Cache};\quad\text{L1-D}=\text{Data Cache}
$$
